description: HSTU - The Golden Flag is five students from Hajee Mohammad Danesh Science and Technology University, Bangladesh. For NASA Space Apps 2026, we are developing Bish-Pani Radar to combine satellite radar and groundwater data for arsenic field-testing triage in the Bengal Delta. Our work spans Earth observation, hydrology, and software. We distinguish measured from demonstration data and communicate uncertainty: ground motion is an indirect indicator, not a measure of water chemistry.
